name: IG-88
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Holowan Laboratories IG chassis locked in a diagnostic rack with severed restraint bands
Mechis III cog-and-circuit totem stamped with a droid-supremacy sigil
Punctured IG skull casing with Boba Fett concussion-grenade scorch marks
vehicleSuggestions: Stolen Imperial freighter used for Mechis III supply runs

factionTrait.name: Sentinal Champion
factionTrait.text: A sentinel moves the turn token +1 step when they have their banner on an objective hex during the end phase.

uniqueTraits.name: Backup Chassis Online
uniqueTraits.text: When IG-88 is knocked out, he is worth 1 step instead of 4. When an enemy is knocked out, IG-88 may immediately make a rally action.

ultimate.name: Mechis III Protocol
ultimate.text: Remove all Mercenary Droids from the battlefield. Then place all three Mercenary Droids on hexes that are within 3 hexes of IG-88.

plotSkills.name: Upload the Objective
plotSkills.text: IG-88 makes a claim action. You may place his banner on any objective hex within range.

plotSkills.name: Execute Hunting Pattern
plotSkills.text: Move each Mercenary Droid that is within range up to 2 hexes.

clashSkills.name: Signal Override
clashSkills.text: If IG-88's banner is within range, place it on an objective hex within range.

clashSkills.name: Reboot Allies
clashSkills.text: All friendly champions within range may make a rally action.

clashSkills.name: Copy Consciousness
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: The Mercenary Droids make a recruit action.

traits.name: Target Lock
traits.text: Enemy models that make an advance action while they are adjacent to a Mercenary Droid have speed 0 during that advance action.

plotSkills.name: Defensive Subroutines
plotSkills.text: If IG-88 is within range, he gains {dodge_boon}.

plotSkills.name: Continuity Protocol
plotSkills.text: If IG-88 is within range, he may make a rally action or move up to 2 hexes.

clashSkills.name: Fresh Off the Line
clashSkills.text: If the Mercenary Droids made a recruit action this activation, Fresh Off the Line has +1 {accuracy_die} and {damage_die}.
